# app build 子命令
# 对应 deploy/build_test.go

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app build list --app $BKMS_APP_ID
stdout .

exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app build list --app $BKMS_APP_ID -o json
stdout .

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app build list
outcontains 'required'

# create error cases
! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app build create --branch main --image-tag v1.0.0
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app build create --app $BKMS_APP_ID --image-tag v1.0.0
outcontains 'required'

! exec $BKMS_CLI_BIN app build create --app $BKMS_APP_ID --branch main
outcontains 'required'
